description: LADOT Metered Parking Inventory & Policies is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Inventory of all on-street metered parking spaces in the City of Los Angeles. Includes Space/Meter ID, block-level address, hourly rate, metered time limit, meter operating hours, enforced parking restrictions, and coordinates. Updated as operationally feasible. See "Parking Meter Occupancy" dataset for real-time parking availability at over 5,000 spaces. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are street cleaning, parking, parking meter, parking policy, express park. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: LADOT Parking Meters Division. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
